literal_meaning: মৃত্যু দ্বারা ধরা পড়া (word-by-word: by death caught)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বয়স্ক মানুষটি হঠাৎ কালে ধরা পড়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: The soldiers were caught by death on the battlefield.
The elderly man was suddenly seized by death.
note: References the personification of death (Kaal or Yama) in Bengali/Hindu cultural context
